question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "condemned".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Praised.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Condemned" means expressed strong disapproval of, or criticized as wrong. (निंदा की गई)
◦ Example: The government condemned the terrorist attack in the strongest terms.

 

• "Praised" means expressed approval or admiration of, and is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रशंसा की)
◦ Example: The principal praised the students for winning the championship.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Denounced (निंदा की): Publicly criticized as wrong — a synonym of condemned, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Censured (भर्त्सना की): Expressed strong formal disapproval of — a synonym of condemned, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Reproached (फटकार लगाई): Expressed disapproval or disappointment towards — a synonym of condemned, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of condemned: denounced, censured, criticized, reproached, rebuked.

 

• Synonyms of praised: applauded, commended, lauded, extolled.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ephemeral (क्षणभंगुर): Permanent (स्थायी), Enduring (चिरस्थायी)

2. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

3. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म/सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (ढीला-ढाला)

4. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

5. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Deceptive (छलपूर्ण), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Vexatious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Pleasant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Vexatious" means causing annoyance, distress, or worry. (कष्टप्रद)

 

• "Pleasant" means agreeable and enjoyable to experience, and figuratively brings comfort rather than irritation. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुखद)
◦ Example: The evening breeze was pleasant after the hot afternoon.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Irritating (चिढ़ाने वाला) — causing annoyance; a synonym in effect, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Troublesome (परेशानी भरा) — causing difficulty or annoyance; a synonym in effect.

 

• Option 4: Bothersome (झंझट भरा) — causing irritation or inconvenience; a synonym in effect.

 

• Other antonyms of vexatious: pleasing, agreeable, soothing, delightful, gratifying.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

2. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

3. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

4. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सावधान), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर करने वाला)

5. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रामक), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "cajole".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Bully.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Cajole" means to persuade someone to do something by flattery or gentle, persistent coaxing. (फुसलाना)
◦ Example: She cajoled her brother into lending her the car.

 

• "Bully" means to intimidate or coerce someone through force or threats, and is therefore the correct antonym. (डराना-धमकाना)
◦ Example: The manager tried to bully the new employee into working overtime.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Coax (मनाना): To gently persuade someone with kind words — a synonym of cajole, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Wheedle (चापलूसी से काम निकालना): To use flattery to get what one wants — a synonym of cajole, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Flatter (चापलूसी करना): To praise insincerely in order to please — a synonym of cajole, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of cajole: coax, wheedle, flatter, persuade, entice.

 

• Synonyms of bully: intimidate, browbeat, coerce, threaten.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Meager (अल्प/कम): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर)

2. Naive (भोला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (व्यवहार-कुशल)

3. Opulent (वैभवशाली): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

4. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

5. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Voluble (वाचाल)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Obsolete."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Current.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obsolete" means no longer in use or produced; out of date. (अप्रचलित)

 

• "Current" means belonging to the present time and still in use, and figuratively up to date with the latest trend. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रचलित)
◦ Example: This is the current version of the software used by most companies.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Outdated (पुराना) — no longer useful or fashionable; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Antiquated (पुराने ज़माने का) — old-fashioned or outdated; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Outmoded (चलन से बाहर) — no longer in fashion or use; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of obsolete: modern, contemporary, up-to-date, prevailing, fashionable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Stoic (भावशून्य/धैर्यवान): Emotional (भावुक), Excitable (उत्तेजित होने वाला)

2. Tenacious (दृढ़): Yielding (झुकने वाला), Irresolute (अनिश्चित)

3. Volatile (अस्थिर): Stable (स्थिर), Steady (अटल)

4. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (निर्लिप्त)

5. Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Antagonistic (विरोधी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "euphemism".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Directness.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Euphemism" means a mild or indirect word or phrase substituted for one considered too harsh or blunt. (शालीन शब्दप्रयोग)
◦ Example: "Passed away" is a common euphemism for "died".

 

• "Directness" means the quality of being straightforward and plain-spoken, without softening or disguising the truth, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्पष्टवादिता)
◦ Example: I appreciated the directness of her feedback on my report.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Understatement (अल्पोक्ति): A statement that presents something as smaller or less important than it is — a synonym in spirit of euphemism, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Circumlocution (घुमा-फिराकर कहना): The use of many words to say something that could be said more directly — a synonym of euphemism, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Indirection (अप्रत्यक्षता): The quality of being indirect or evasive in expression — a synonym of euphemism, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of euphemism: understatement, circumlocution, indirection, mincing words.

 

• Synonyms of directness: bluntness, candor, forthrightness, frankness.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Disjointed (टूटा-फूटा)

2. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (उद्दंड), Rebellious (विद्रोही)

3. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्टवक्ता), Tongue-tied (गूंगा-सा)

4. Feasible (संभव): Impossible (असंभव), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

5. Genuine (असली): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Elucidate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Obscure.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Elucidate" means to make something clear; to explain in detail. (स्पष्ट करना)

 

• "Obscure" means to make something unclear or difficult to understand, and figuratively to hide it from view rather than clarify it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अस्पष्ट करना)
◦ Example: The jargon in the report only served to obscure his main point.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Clarify (स्पष्ट करना) — to make an idea or statement clearer; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Explain (समझाना) — to make something plain or understandable; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Illuminate (प्रकाशित करना) — to make a subject clear through explanation; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of elucidate: confuse, obfuscate, muddle, cloud, complicate.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रवत), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

2. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (परिश्रमी), Industrious (मेहनती)

3. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Foolish (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Rash (उतावला)

4. Kindle (जलाना/प्रज्वलित करना): Extinguish (बुझाना), Douse (बुझा देना)

5. Lament (विलाप करना): Rejoice (खुशी मनाना), Celebrate (उत्सव मनाना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "monstrous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Beautiful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Monstrous" means extremely ugly, frightening, or shockingly wrong. (विकराल/भयानक)
◦ Example: The dictator was accused of monstrous crimes against his own people.

 

• "Beautiful" means pleasing to the senses or the mind, attractive and lovely to look at, and is therefore the correct antonym. (सुंदर)
◦ Example: The sunset over the mountains was truly beautiful.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Hideous (बीभत्स): Extremely ugly or repulsive to look at — a synonym of monstrous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Grotesque (भद्दा/विचित्र): Distorted and unnatural in a disturbing way — a synonym of monstrous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Ghastly (डरावना): Causing great horror or fear — a synonym of monstrous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of monstrous: hideous, grotesque, ghastly, horrific, appalling.

 

• Synonyms of beautiful: lovely, gorgeous, exquisite, attractive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Malign (बदनाम करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Compliment (तारीफ करना)

2. Notorious (कुख्यात): Reputable (प्रतिष्ठित), Esteemed (सम्मानित)

3. Optimistic (आशावादी): Pessimistic (निराशावादी), Cynical (संशयवादी)

4. Placid (शांत): Agitated (उत्तेजित), Excitable (उत्तेजनशील)

5. Quell (दबाना/शांत करना): Incite (भड़काना), Provoke (उकसाना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Egalitarian."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Biased.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Egalitarian" means believing in or based on the principle that all people are equal and deserve equal rights and opportunities. (समतावादी)

 

• "Biased" means showing an unfair preference for or against a particular person or group, and figuratively treating people unequally rather than as equals. It is therefore the correct antonym. (पक्षपाती)
◦ Example: The referee's biased decisions angered the visiting team's fans.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Equitable (न्यायसंगत) — fair and impartial to all; a synonym of egalitarian, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Impartial (निष्पक्ष) — treating all sides equally; a synonym of egalitarian, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Equal (समान) — having the same status or rights; a synonym of egalitarian, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of egalitarian: elitist, discriminatory, unequal, prejudiced, hierarchical.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Rigid (कठोर/अटल): Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनीय)

2. Somber (उदास/गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्नचित्त), Jovial (हंसमुख)

3. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Audacious (दुःसाहसी)

4. Unanimous (सर्वसम्मत): Divided (विभाजित), Dissenting (असहमत)

5. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Terse (रूखा/संक्षिप्त)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "turbulent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Calm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Turbulent" means marked by conflict, disorder, or violent change; not calm or stable. (अशांत)
◦ Example: The country went through a turbulent period after the coup.

 

• "Calm" means free from disturbance, agitation, or violent change; peaceful and steady, and is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)
◦ Example: The sea was calm and still on the morning of the voyage.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Chaotic (अराजक): Marked by complete disorder and confusion — a synonym of turbulent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Tumultuous (हलचल भरा): Full of noisy commotion or upheaval — a synonym of turbulent, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Stormy (तूफानी): Marked by violent disturbance or strong emotion — a synonym of turbulent, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of turbulent: chaotic, tumultuous, stormy, unruly, volatile.

 

• Synonyms of calm: peaceful, tranquil, serene, placid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Wane (घटना/क्षीण होना): Wax (बढ़ना), Increase (बढ़ोतरी होना)

2. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Sparse (विरल)

3. Bleak (निराशाजनक): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Promising (आशाजनक)

4. Cordial (सौहार्दपूर्ण): Cold (उदासीन), Unfriendly (अमित्रवत)

5. Dormant (निष्क्रिय/सुप्त): Active (सक्रिय), Alert (सतर्क)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ineluctable."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Preventably.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ineluctable" means impossible to avoid or resist; certain to happen. (अपरिहार्य)

 

• "Preventably" means in a manner that can be stopped or avoided, and figuratively describes an outcome that is not fixed or inevitable at all. It is therefore the correct antonym. (निवार्य रूप से)
◦ Example: The accident was preventably caused by a lack of safety checks.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Inevitably (अनिवार्य रूप से) — in a way that is certain to happen; a synonym of ineluctable, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Inescapably (अपरिहार्य रूप से) — in a way that cannot be escaped; a synonym of ineluctable, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Unavoidably (अनिवार्यतः) — in a way that cannot be avoided; a synonym of ineluctable, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of ineluctable: avoidable, escapable, preventable, evitable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Enigmatic (रहस्यमय): Clear (स्पष्ट), Transparent (पारदर्शी)

2. Fickle (चंचल/अस्थिर): Constant (स्थिर), Steadfast (दृढ़)

3. Gaudy (भड़कीला): Elegant (सुरुचिपूर्ण), Tasteful (शालीन)

4. Haughty (घमंडी): Modest (विनम्र), Humble (नम्र)

5. Inept (अयोग्य): Skilled (कुशल), Competent (सक्षम)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "garrulous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Reserved.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Garrulous" means excessively talkative, especially about trivial things. (बातूनी)
◦ Example: My garrulous neighbor kept me on the phone for over an hour.

 

• "Reserved" means slow to reveal emotion or opinions; reticent and quiet in manner, and is therefore the correct antonym. (संकोची)
◦ Example: He is quite reserved and rarely speaks unless spoken to.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Talkative (बातूनी): Fond of talking a great deal — a synonym of garrulous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Loquacious (वाचाल): Tending to talk a great deal; very talkative — a synonym of garrulous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Chatty (गपशप करने वाला): Fond of casual, friendly conversation — a synonym of garrulous, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of garrulous: talkative, loquacious, chatty, voluble, verbose.

 

• Synonyms of reserved: reticent, taciturn, quiet, uncommunicative.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sad (उदास), Dejected (निराश)

2. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (निर्लिप्त)

3. Languid (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोशीला)

4. Nimble (फुर्तीला): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

5. Obstinate (हठी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Noisome."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Fragrant.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Noisome" means having an extremely offensive smell; harmful or noxious. (दुर्गंधयुक्त)

 

• "Fragrant" means having a pleasant, sweet smell, and figuratively delightful to the senses rather than offensive. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सुगंधित)
◦ Example: The garden was filled with fragrant roses in full bloom.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Foul (बदबूदार) — having a highly offensive smell or taste; a synonym of noisome, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Fetid (सड़ी हुई दुर्गंध वाला) — smelling extremely unpleasant; a synonym of noisome, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Malodorous (दुर्गंधयुक्त) — having an unpleasant or offensive smell; a synonym of noisome, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of noisome: pleasant, sweet-smelling, aromatic, wholesome.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Perilous (खतरनाक): Safe (सुरक्षित), Secure (निश्चिंत)

2. Robust (मजबूत): Frail (दुर्बल), Weak (कमजोर)

3. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (अविवेकी)

4. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

5. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Scarce (अल्प)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "surreptitious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Overt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Surreptitious" means done secretly or stealthily, especially because it would not be approved of if noticed. (गुप्त/चोरी-छिपे)
◦ Example: He took a surreptitious glance at his phone during the meeting.

 

• "Overt" means done or shown openly; not secret or hidden, and is therefore the correct antonym. (खुला/प्रकट)
◦ Example: The company made an overt attempt to attract younger customers.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Clandestine (गुप्त): Kept secret or done secretively, often for an illicit purpose — a synonym of surreptitious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Covert (छिपा हुआ): Not openly acknowledged or displayed; hidden — a synonym of surreptitious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Furtive (चोरी-छिपे): Attempting to avoid notice or attention, typically because of guilt — a synonym of surreptitious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of surreptitious: clandestine, covert, furtive, stealthy, secretive.

 

• Synonyms of overt: open, obvious, apparent, manifest.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vapid (नीरस): Interesting (दिलचस्प), Stimulating (प्रेरक)

2. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला), Careless (लापरवाह)

3. Zesty (जोशीला): Bland (फीका), Dull (नीरस)

4. Astute (चतुर): Foolish (मूर्ख), Naive (भोला)

5. Brazen (निर्लज्ज): Timid (डरपोक), Shy (शर्मीला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Obloquy."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Praise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Obloquy" means strong public criticism or verbal abuse, and the state of disgrace that results from it. (अपयश)

 

• "Praise" means the expression of approval or admiration for someone, and figuratively brings honor rather than disgrace. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रशंसा)
◦ Example: The soldier received widespread praise for his act of bravery.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Vilification (बदनामी) — abusive or slanderous talk that damages reputation; a synonym of obloquy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Denunciation (सार्वजनिक निंदा) — public condemnation of someone; a synonym of obloquy, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Censure (भर्त्सना) — expression of strong disapproval; a synonym of obloquy, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of obloquy: acclaim, honor, admiration, esteem, tribute.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Munificent (दानशील): Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण)

2. Placate (शांत करना): Provoke (उकसाना), Antagonize (विरोधी बनाना)

3. Rescind (रद्द करना): Enact (लागू करना), Implement (कार्यान्वित करना)

4. Stagnant (रुका हुआ): Flowing (बहता हुआ), Dynamic (गतिशील)

5. Vindicate (निर्दोष सिद्ध करना): Blame (दोष देना), Accuse (आरोप लगाना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "quaint".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Ordinary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Quaint" means attractively unusual or old-fashioned, especially in a charming way. (विचित्र किन्तु आकर्षक, पुराने ढंग का)
◦ Example: The village had a quaint charm with its cobbled streets and thatched cottages.

 

• "Ordinary" means common, usual, or not special in any way, and is therefore the correct antonym. (साधारण)
◦ Example: After the tour of quaint villages, returning to the ordinary city streets felt dull.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Curious (विचित्र): Means strange or odd in an interesting way — a synonym of quaint, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Old-fashioned (पुराने ढंग का): Means outdated in style, close in meaning to quaint — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Charming (आकर्षक): Means pleasing and attractive, matching quaint's sense of charm — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of quaint: curious, old-fashioned, charming, picturesque, old-world.

 

• Synonyms of ordinary: common, usual, average, normal, unremarkable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Benevolent (दयालु): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

2. Diligent (परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Indolent (सुस्त)

3. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Deceptive (छलपूर्ण), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

4. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Terse (संक्षिप्त एवं स्पष्ट)

5. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Audacious (दुस्साहसी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Misanthropic."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Sociable.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Misanthropic" means having a deep dislike or distrust of humanity in general. (मानवद्वेषी)

 

• "Sociable" means friendly and enjoying the company of others, and practically someone who seeks out social interaction rather than avoiding it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (मिलनसार)
◦ Example: Despite his misanthropic reputation, his sociable neighbour greeted everyone warmly each morning.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Cynical (निंदक) — distrustful of others' motives, close in spirit to misanthropic; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Antisocial (समाज-विरोधी) — avoiding or opposed to social contact, aligning with misanthropic; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Reclusive (एकांतप्रिय) — preferring isolation from others, consistent with misanthropic; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of misanthropic: friendly, gregarious, humanitarian, warm-hearted, benevolent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (गंभीर)

2. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

3. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (अस्तव्यस्त)

4. Genuine (असली): Fake (नकली), Fraudulent (धोखाधड़ी वाला)

5. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "exacerbate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Alleviate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Exacerbate" means to make a problem, situation, or feeling worse. (बदतर बनाना)
◦ Example: Ignoring the leak will only exacerbate the damage to the ceiling.

 

• "Alleviate" means to make a problem or suffering less severe, and is therefore the correct antonym. (कम करना, राहत देना)
◦ Example: The new medicine helped alleviate her chronic back pain.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Aggravate (और बिगाड़ना): Means to make worse, essentially the same as exacerbate — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Worsen (बदतर करना): Means to become or make worse, matching exacerbate's meaning — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Intensify (तीव्र करना): Means to increase in strength or degree, similar to exacerbate — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of exacerbate: aggravate, worsen, intensify, inflame, compound.

 

• Synonyms of alleviate: relieve, ease, mitigate, soothe, lessen.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Resilient (लचीला): Fragile (नाजुक), Weak (कमजोर)

2. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़)

3. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (अहंकारी), Proud (घमंडी)

4. Ample (पर्याप्त): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

5. Vivid (जीवंत): Dull (फीका), Faded (धुंधला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Reprobate."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Virtuous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Reprobate" means an unprincipled or immoral person, someone with a corrupt or depraved character. (दुराचारी)

 

• "Virtuous" means having high moral standards and behaving in a righteous way, and practically someone whose conduct is admired rather than condemned. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सदाचारी)
◦ Example: Unlike his reprobate uncle, the young man led a virtuous and disciplined life.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Scoundrel (बदमाश) — a dishonest or unscrupulous person; a synonym of reprobate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Degenerate (पतित) — a person who has declined in morals or standards, matching reprobate; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Villain (खलनायक) — a wicked or malicious person, close to reprobate in meaning; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of reprobate: saint, upright, honourable, righteous, moral.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Tranquil (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अव्यवस्थित)

2. Zealous (उत्साही): Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (निरुत्साह)

3. Robust (मजबूत): Feeble (कमजोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

4. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला)

5. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला), Vague (अस्पष्ट)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "apathy".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Enthusiasm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Apathy" means a lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern about something. (उदासीनता)
◦ Example: Voter apathy was evident from the extremely low turnout in the election.

 

• "Enthusiasm" means intense and eager interest or excitement, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उत्साह)
◦ Example: The new coach brought fresh enthusiasm to the struggling team.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Indifference (उदासीनता): Means a lack of interest or concern, essentially the same as apathy — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Lethargy (सुस्ती): Means a lack of energy or enthusiasm, closely related to apathy — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Listlessness (निढालपन): Means a lack of energy or spirit, similar in sense to apathy — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of apathy: indifference, lethargy, listlessness, unconcern, disinterest.

 

• Synonyms of enthusiasm: eagerness, zeal, passion, excitement, fervour.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Opulent (विलासितापूर्ण): Impoverished (निर्धन), Poor (गरीब)

2. Placate (शांत करना): Provoke (उकसाना), Incense (क्रोधित करना)

3. Garrulous (बकबक करने वाला): Reticent (अल्पभाषी), Taciturn (मौन प्रवृत्ति का)

4. Ostentatious (दिखावटी): Modest (सादा), Understated (सादगीपूर्ण)

5. Meager (अल्प): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (बहुतायत में)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Derelict."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Attentive.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Derelict" means neglectful of duty or responsibility, failing to do what one is expected to do. (कर्तव्य में लापरवाह)

 

• "Attentive" means paying close attention to one's duties and responsibilities, and practically someone who is careful and diligent rather than neglectful. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सावधान)
◦ Example: The attentive lifeguard noticed the struggling swimmer immediately.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Negligent (लापरवाह) — failing to take proper care, essentially the same as derelict; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Careless (असावधान) — not giving enough attention, matching derelict's sense of neglect; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Remiss (कर्तव्य के प्रति उदासीन) — lacking care in performing duty, close to derelict in meaning; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of derelict: diligent, conscientious, dutiful, careful, responsible.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nefarious (दुष्ट): Righteous (धर्मी), Honorable (सम्मानित)

2. Capricious (मनमौजी): Consistent (सुसंगत), Steady (स्थिर)

3. Vindictive (प्रतिशोधी): Forgiving (क्षमाशील), Compassionate (दयालु)

4. Torpid (निष्क्रिय): Active (सक्रिय), Energetic (ऊर्जावान)

5. Fastidious (चूज़ी): Careless (लापरवाह), Undemanding (कम मांग वाला)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "tenebrous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Bright.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Tenebrous" means dark, shadowy, or gloomy. (अंधकारमय)
◦ Example: The tenebrous corridors of the old castle unsettled every visitor.

 

• "Bright" means full of light; radiant or shining, and is therefore the correct antonym. (उज्ज्वल, चमकीला)
◦ Example: A bright morning sun replaced the tenebrous fog of the night before.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Dark (अंधेरा): Means lacking light, essentially the same as tenebrous — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Murky (धुंधला): Means dark and gloomy, especially with obscured visibility — a synonym of tenebrous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Gloomy (अंधकारमय): Means dark or dismal in a way that matches tenebrous — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of tenebrous: dark, murky, gloomy, shadowy, dim.

 

• Synonyms of bright: radiant, luminous, shining, brilliant, vivid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (संकोची), Introverted (अंतर्मुखी)

2. Austere (सादा): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Lavish (भव्य)

3. Belligerent (आक्रामक): Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

4. Clandestine (गुप्त): Open (खुला), Public (सार्वजनिक)

5. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (उद्दंड), Defiant (विद्रोही)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ephemeral."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Eternal.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ephemeral" means lasting for a very short time; short-lived. (क्षणभंगुर)

 

• "Eternal" means lasting forever, without beginning or end, and practically something that endures rather than fades quickly. It is therefore the correct antonym. (शाश्वत)
◦ Example: Poets often speak of eternal love that outlasts the ephemeral pleasures of youth.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Transient (अस्थायी) — existing only briefly, essentially the same as ephemeral; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Fleeting (क्षणभंगुर) — passing quickly, matching ephemeral's meaning closely; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Momentary (क्षणिक) — lasting only a moment, consistent with ephemeral; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of ephemeral: permanent, everlasting, enduring, lasting, perpetual.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Erudite (विद्वान): Ignorant (अज्ञानी), Uneducated (अशिक्षित)

2. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया)

3. Jubilant (हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Dejected (निराश)

4. Lavish (भव्य): Meager (अल्प), Sparing (मितव्ययी)

5. Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण): Kindhearted (दयालु हृदय वाला), Charitable (उदार)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "somnolent".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Awake.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Somnolent" means sleepy or drowsy, tending to induce sleep. (तंद्रालु, उनींदा)
◦ Example: The warm afternoon sun made the whole class feel somnolent.

 

• "Awake" means not asleep; alert and conscious, and is therefore the correct antonym. (जागृत)
◦ Example: Despite the late hour, she remained fully awake and focused on her work.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Drowsy (तंद्रालु): Means feeling sleepy or sluggish, essentially the same as somnolent — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Sleepy (नींद भरा): Means ready to fall asleep, matching somnolent's meaning — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Lethargic (सुस्त): Means sluggish and lacking energy, closely related to somnolent — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of somnolent: drowsy, sleepy, lethargic, dozy, torpid.

 

• Synonyms of awake: alert, conscious, wakeful, vigilant, aware.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nomadic (खानाबदोश): Settled (स्थायी रूप से बसा हुआ), Stationary (स्थिर)

2. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (अनुपालनशील)

3. Placid (शांत): Agitated (विचलित), Volatile (अस्थिर)

4. Querulous (शिकायती): Contented (संतुष्ट), Uncomplaining (बिना शिकायत के)

5. Rancorous (कटु): Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Forgiving (क्षमाशील)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Parsimonious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Generous.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Parsimonious" means extremely unwilling to spend money or use resources; excessively frugal. (कंजूस)

 

• "Generous" means willing to give freely and share resources, and practically someone who spends or gives without excessive restraint. It is therefore the correct antonym. (उदार)
◦ Example: Despite his wealth, the parsimonious landlord was nothing like his generous father.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Stingy (कंजूस) — unwilling to spend or give, essentially the same as parsimonious; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Miserly (सूम) — extremely reluctant to spend money, matching parsimonious closely; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Frugal (मितव्ययी) — economical and sparing in spending, aligning with parsimonious; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of parsimonious: lavish, extravagant, liberal, munificent, bountiful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ)

2. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

3. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Uncommon (असामान्य)

4. Vacillate (डगमगाना): Resolve (दृढ़ निश्चय करना), Commit (प्रतिबद्ध होना)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (विश्वासी), Unsuspecting (बिना शक किए)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "concomitant".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Independent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Concomitant" means occurring or existing together with something else; naturally accompanying it. (सहवर्ती)
◦ Example: Rising prices are often a concomitant effect of a growing economy.

 

• "Independent" means existing or occurring separately, not connected to or affected by something else, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वतंत्र)
◦ Example: Her success was independent of her family's wealth or connections.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Accompanying (साथ चलने वाला): Means going along with something else, essentially the same as concomitant — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Associated (संबद्ध): Means connected or linked with something, matching concomitant's meaning — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Attendant (सहगामी): Means accompanying as a natural consequence, closely related to concomitant — a synonym, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of concomitant: accompanying, associated, attendant, concurrent, related.

 

• Synonyms of independent: separate, autonomous, self-governing, unconnected, free.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Xenophobic (विदेशियों से घृणा रखने वाला): Welcoming (स्वागत करने वाला), Tolerant (सहिष्णु)

2. Yielding (समर्पणशील): Resistant (प्रतिरोधी), Stubborn (जिद्दी)

3. Zenith (शिखर): Nadir (निम्नतम बिंदु), Bottom (तल)

4. Abhor (घृणा करना): Adore (बहुत प्रेम करना), Love (प्रेम करना)

5. Buoyant (प्रफुल्लित): Depressed (उदास), Gloomy (निराशाजनक)
